info.name: Pathway Analysis Service database identifier API
Analyse the identifier over the different species in the database

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the element to be retrieved

params.name: interactors
params.description: Include interactors

params.name: species
params.description: list of species to filter the result (accepts taxonomy ids, species names and dbId)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: pathways per page

params.name: page
params.description: page number

params.name: pValue
params.description: defines the pValue threshold. Only hit pathway with pValue equals or below the threshold will be returned

params.name: includeDisease
params.description: set to 'false' to exclude the disease pathways from the result (it does not alter the statistics)

params.name: min
params.description: minimum number of contained entities per pathway (takes into account the resource)

params.name: max
params.description: maximum number of contained entities per pathway (takes into account the resource)

params.name: importableOnly
params.description: Filters resources to only includes importable ones

items.docs: Use page and pageSize to reduce the amount of data retrieved. Use sortBy and order to sort the result by your preferred option. The resource field will filter the results to show only those corresponding to the preferred molecule type (TOTAL includes all the different molecules type)

info.name: Analyse the identifier over the different species in the database and projects the result to Homo Sapiens

params.name: id
params.description: The identifier of the element to be retrieved

params.name: interactors
params.description: Include interactors

params.name: species
params.description: list of species to filter the result (accepts taxonomy ids, species names and dbId)

params.name: pageSize
params.description: pathways per page

params.name: page
params.description: page number

params.name: pValue
params.description: defines the pValue threshold. Only hit pathway with pValue equals or below the threshold will be returned

params.name: includeDisease
params.description: set to 'false' to exclude the disease pathways from the result (it does not alter the statistics)

params.name: min
params.description: minimum number of contained entities per pathway (takes into account the resource)

params.name: max
params.description: maximum number of contained entities per pathway (takes into account the resource)

items.docs: The projection is calculated by the orthologous slot in the Reactome database. Use page and pageSize to reduce the amount of data retrieved. Use sortBy and order to sort the result by your preferred option. The resource field will filter the results to show only those corresponding to the preferred molecule type (TOTAL includes all the different molecules type)
